description: NoOps Configuration: Auto-merge minor/patch updates, PRs for major versions and critical frameworks

packageRules.description: NoOps: Auto-merge ALL minor, patch, and digest updates by default
Major updates require manual review via PR
Critical frameworks - require manual review even for minor/patch
Keep Node.js on v22 LTS — v24 not yet validated

Hold pnpm packageManager at v10 — v11 enforces a default minimumReleaseAge policy that rejects freshly-published packages (breaks install/CI whenever a dependency was published within the cutoff, e.g. a same-day vite bump). Adopting v11 needs a deliberate minimumReleaseAge policy decision in pnpm-workspace.yaml plus CI validation; the earlier pnpm.overrides blocker is already resolved (overrides removed).
Hold TypeScript at v6 — v7 waits for TypeScript 7.1 and for ESLint support of TypeScript 7 (svelte-check also needs TypeScript 6 beside 7 and --tsgo). Lift this rule by hand once both are out.
